privacy.meta.title: Privacy Policy - TypeWhisper
privacy.meta.description: TypeWhisper privacy policy. Local-first by default, no mandatory telemetry, and explicit opt-in for cloud or custom endpoints.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.section.overview.title: Overview
privacy.section.overview.p1: TypeWhisper is a local-first desktop app for macOS and Windows. By default, data is processed entirely on your device. If you explicitly configure a cloud or custom endpoint, the data needed for that request is sent to that provider.
privacy.section.dataCollection.title: Data Collection
privacy.section.dataCollection.p1: TypeWhisper does not collect telemetry by default. Audio processing, transcription, and storage happen locally on your device by default. No audio or transcription data is sent to TypeWhisper-operated servers. If you opt into a cloud engine or configure a custom endpoint, data for that request is sent to the selected provider.
privacy.section.analytics.title: Website Analytics and Attribution
privacy.section.analytics.p1: The TypeWhisper website uses Plausible Analytics to measure aggregate page visits, referring domains, campaign parameters, download choices, and checkout starts. Plausible does not set tracking cookies or store raw IP addresses. Download events contain only the platform, download target, page placement, language, and optional public app version; they never contain email addresses, license keys, audio, or transcription content. Standard UTM campaign parameters are kept in session storage for the current browser session and forwarded to Polar when checkout starts. No persistent visitor ID or cross-device profile is created by TypeWhisper.
privacy.section.localStorage.title: Local Storage
privacy.section.localStorage.p1: TypeWhisper stores the following data locally in your OS-specific app data directory (for example Application Support on macOS or AppData on Windows):
privacy.section.localStorage.p2: This data is stored on your device by default and is not accessible to us. Optional cloud or custom endpoints only receive the request data you explicitly route to them.
privacy.section.network.title: Network Access
privacy.section.network.p1: By default, TypeWhisper connects to the internet only to download AI models from Hugging Face. After models are downloaded, the app can function offline. If you enable a cloud engine or configure a custom endpoint, the app also connects to that selected service for processing.
privacy.section.thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
privacy.section.thirdParty.p1: The website uses Plausible for aggregate analytics and Polar for checkout, payment, licensing, and purchase attribution. The desktop apps do not contain advertising trackers and do not send usage, audio, or transcription telemetry to TypeWhisper.
privacy.section.securityReview.title: Law-Firm Security Review
privacy.section.securityReview.beforeLin: For firm IT and privacy review, there is also a
privacy.section.securityReview.linkText: public checklist covering data flow, storage locations, and optional cloud building blocks
privacy.section.openSource.title: Open Source
privacy.section.openSource.p1: TypeWhisper is open source under the GPLv3 license. You can audit the entire source code on GitHub.
privacy.section.contact.title: Contact
privacy.section.contact.p1: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please open an issue on our GitHub organization.
